story_sequence.text: Beacon uses `version aggregate projection` wording and does not call aggregate change payloads requirement truth.
A QA accepted current feature has a deterministic feature change projection input or a repairable missing-projection finding.
`release create` rebuilds version aggregate projection from feature change projections and preserves explicit feature dependency order.
`release check` fails closed when the current QA accepted feature is missing from version aggregate projection.
`release check` passes aggregate inclusion when the current QA accepted feature is included in version aggregate projection.
Doctor exposes repair-only projection rebuild / verify behavior for feature projection, version aggregate projection, and test-contract-index.
test-contract-index refresh / verify is part of projection repair closure when stale index risk is reported.
The guard does not add a new lifecycle stage, required human-facing command, release publish action, or post-release install action.
Tests cover missing projection, repaired projection, aggregate feature count/list, dependency order, and wording boundaries.
Blocked release output gives actionable repair guidance for projection inclusion failure.
